messages.subject: For Kent Masters | Lithium growth, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Albemarle Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Kent Masters, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Albemarle's global lithium platform sits at the center of energy-transition supply chains, making government relationships, community confidence, responsible resource development and strategic partnerships increasingly important to long-term growth.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial renewable-energy infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a conversation about where this country-facing mining and stakeholder experience might support Albemarle's critical-minerals growth, external affairs, sustainability or international partnerships. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
